verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the heart of Marseille's historic Panier district and rises above the Vieux Port.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of Marseille’s historic Panier, InterContinental Marseille – Hotel Dieu rises above the Vieux Port

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies an 18th-century landmark inaugurated by Napoleon III.
verified_facts.excerpt: rises above the Vieux Port in a stunning 18th-century landmark inaugurated by Napoleon III.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a panoramic terrace with a view of Notre-Dame de la Garde.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our panoramic terrace with view of Notre-Dame de la Garde

verified_facts.text: The SPA by Clarins is inspired by traditional Provencal fountains and lavoirs, communal clothes-washing places.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the traditional Provencal fountains and lavoirs (communal clothes’ washing places), the SPA by Clarins offers time out from everyday life.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
Guests can unwind in the indoor pool and have treatments at the Spa by Clarins.
verified_facts.excerpt: unwind in the indoor pool, and indulge in treatments at the Spa by Clarins

verified_facts.text: Les Fenetres restaurant and the Capian bar both have views of the Vieux Port and dishes and cocktails using the freshness of Provence.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both feature breathtaking views of the Vieux Port and a selection of dishes and cocktails incorporating the freshness of Provence.

verified_facts.text: At the Capian Bar guests can have a signature gin-based Etincelle cocktail or enjoy Vieux-Port views from a terrace table.
verified_facts.excerpt: savour a signature, gin-based Etincelle, or enjoy Vieux-Port views from a terrace table.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can help guests book a tour boat to discover the Calanques.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Concierge will be proud and indeed delighted, to help you book a tourboat; the best way to discover the splendour of the Calanques.

verified_facts.text: The MuCEM museum is about 0.89 kilometers from the hotel.
La Vieille Charite is about 0.4 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Vieille Charité - 0.25 miles away (0.4 kilometers)

verified_facts.text: Dogs receive a personalised dog kit with a plaid, a bowl and a rug.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please ask name of dog as we offer a "kit dog" : a plaid, a bowl, and a rug personalised.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is certified with the Green Key eco-label.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is certified with Green Key (FEE)

verified_facts.text: Marseille Provence Airport is about 18 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: approximately 11.18 miles away (18 kilometers) from the hotel

verified_facts.text: Guest parking is at basement level, on booking request and subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking is available for guests at basement level, on booking request and upon avaibility

verified_facts.text: A nanny is available for hire.
